items.title: Announcing Cloudflare Wallets: the programmable wallet for the agentic Internet
items.summary: Today, it is difficult for AI agents to try out new APIs. They often have to navigate through a login page designed for humans and not agents, contact a human to add a payment method, generate an API key, and then figure out how to call the API. items.summaryZh: Cloudflare推出了“智能体钱包”（Cloudflare Wallets），旨在为AI智能体提供稳定的身份标识和自主支付能力。该方案支持x402协议，允许智能体通过虚拟钱包安全地购买API服务、工具及内容。通过设置交易限额和白名单等防护机制，该系统为构建“智能体经济”提供了关键的支付与合规基础设施。

Our spec reviewer agent has evaluated close to 600 technical designs against the same standards before implementation began. Both systems draw from the Cloudflare Codex, a shared source of engineering guidance
